body:
Resolved the conflict with upstream #442 (Stock page theme button) in merge `17dcd7bf` (upstream/main merged into this branch):

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`: both sides added a test module at the same spot. Kept both: this branch's `mod mcp_live;` and #442's `mod theme_door;`.

Gate (`scripts/gate.sh quick upstream/main`, app + ui suites): all 8 pinning tests pass (6 in `mcp_live`, including the real loopback TCP test, and 2 in `egui_app::tests::mcp_live`), and #442's 5 `theme_door` tests pass on this tree too. The only reds are the known ones that also fail on main: the GPU headless tests (`headless_run_succeeds`, `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`, `egui_headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`) and `setup_stock_source::a_new_block_after_a_flip…` (#415, fixed by #420).

The branch merges cleanly with main. It stays a draft until the GUI check. The test binaries `camcraft-ui-428` and `camcraft-cli-428` will be rebuilt from this tree.
